summary: Data delivery is implemented through multiple channels: CSV export (directory-export.test.ts verifies token-gated access), API access (/api route documented), lead list pages with filtering, and provider detail pages. The live site at https://www.caregist.co.uk delivers: search results, lead lists filtered by opportunity, provider detail pages, CSV exports (token-gated). The API health endpoints provide observability: /api/v1/health/*, /api/v1/version (deployed SHA), /data-status (freshness). The directory-db test verifies data access patterns.
assertions: CSV export with access token gating (directory-export.test.ts)
API route documented at /api on live site
Lead lists delivered via filtered pages (lead-list, search)
Provider detail pages serve full CQC data
